name: lavia lactea
author: lappwv
description: Hold to the ceiling before the normal size portal at 20% as the wave. Move down at 23% and then spam between the platform and spikes until 24% where you can move back to the ceiling. Move down at 26.3% and then move back to the ceiling at 26.7% between the slope and robot portal, (optional) move down a bit to get the coin at 28%. Move to the floor at 29%. Move back to the ceiling at 32% and then hold back to the floor at 34.9%. Fall up at 36% to get the normal gravity portal and then fall back to the floor. Move up at 45% to get the normal size portal and then fall back to the floor. Move to the middle of the level at 46.7% and spam in that range until 48.5% where you can fall back to the floor. Move up at 69.5% and spam slightly below the orbs and then at 71%, move above the orb, fall slightly down and then go between the two orbs at 72% and then stay a bit below the ceiling until 73% where you can hold back to the ceiling. Move a bit down at 74% and spam between the saw and structure with the spikes until 75.1% where you can fall back to the floor between the structure and block. Move a tiny bit above the floor at 81.6% and then go back to the floor at 82.4%. Move up at 83% between the structure and block (hold through the orb), avoid the ceiling spike at 83.9% and then hold to the ceiling at 84%. Move slightly down at 85% to avoid the slope and blocks and then hold back to the ceiling at 85.9%. Move a bit down at 88.7% and then go back to the ceiling at 89.2% after passing the structure on the ceiling. Fall to the floor at 93.9% and then (optional) move to the ceiling at 95.1% to get the coin at 97%. Free to the end from there.
